newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: COLOMBIAN STOCKS SHOOT UP ON BEER, BANK DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: COLOMBIAN STOCKS SHOOT UP ON BEER, BANK DEMAND.

text.p: Colombian stocks shot up on local and foreign fund demand for blue chips, traders said Monday.
Bogota's IBB price index finished ahead two percent at 1,284.37 on volume of four billion pesos. Medellin's IBOMED general price index closed up 1.45 percent at 19,207.63 on trading of 4.9 billion.
"The markets were moved by heavy demand for Bavaria and Banco de Bogota," said a broker. Brewing giant Bavaria jumped 4.13 percent to 9,898 pesos in Bogota and up 3.76 percent to 9,909 in Medellin.
Brokers forecast that Bavaria could go as high as 12,000 if the current level of demand holds.
Banco de Bogota closed up 1.84 percent at 6,900 in Bogota. Cigarette-maker Coltabaco closed up 1.26 percent to 4,000 in Bogota.
In Medellin, insurer Suramericana held steady at 28,780 on volume of 925 million pesos.
